selectionPolicy: Use only today's strongest clean-skin Devi looks from the latest Met outputs.
Exclude stills with obvious face drift, hair lock break, or tattoo/body-art visibility.
Prioritize looks that stay readable after 4:5 feed conversion.

looks.label: Noir crystal column
looks.face_fidelity: Strongest direct resemblance in the clean-skin pool.
looks.glam_impact: High-contrast noir glamour with camera-ready sparkle.
looks.outfit_clarity: Full-body column gown remains readable after 4:5 conversion.
looks.lighting_polish: Controlled studio light keeps skin and sequins clean.
why_selected: Closest overall match to Devi's face shape and pastel hair lock.
Black sequined silhouette reads instantly even with short feed-view attention.
Plain editorial background gives us reliable negative space for text overlays.

looks.label: Classic champagne couture
looks.face_fidelity: Strong and recognizable with good eye shape continuity.
looks.outfit_clarity: Architectural bodice and full skirt stay legible in feed crop.
looks.lighting_polish: Warm carpet lights and soft flash read beautifully.
why_selected: Very stable face read with Devi's softer glam expression.
Champagne satin and gala aisle give prestige without visual clutter.
Works well for both wide silhouette cards and tighter phrase-led crops.

looks.label: Floral staircase statement
looks.face_fidelity: Strong enough to keep Devi recognizable while carrying a bigger look.
looks.glam_impact: Top-tier visual drama and lush couture texture.
looks.outfit_clarity: 3D floral applique and train stay readable at first glance.
looks.lighting_polish: Warm staircase glow flatters both skin and fabric depth.
why_selected: Highest glam impact in the set with unmistakable floral couture drama.
Hair still reads as Devi, while the color story feels premium and editorial.
Stair architecture supports strong top- or bottom-text compositions.

looks.label: Grand staircase cape hero
looks.face_fidelity: Stable and flattering with good resemblance to the identity reference.
looks.glam_impact: Grand but controlled, with strong luxury-finale energy.
looks.outfit_clarity: Cape shape and corseted bodice read immediately.
looks.lighting_polish: Even staircase light supports both warm and neutral card grades.
why_selected: Stable face fidelity with prestige red-carpet posture.
The cape-and-column silhouette feels like classic Met closing-night glamour.
Symmetrical staircase layout gives us polished, luxury-safe text placement.

looks.label: Sculptural cape architecture
looks.face_fidelity: Good enough to use as a drama anchor in the shortlist.
looks.glam_impact: Strong sculptural authority and deep-carpet presence.
looks.outfit_clarity: Upper-shell structure and cape spread are obvious from distance.
looks.lighting_polish: Soft monumental light keeps the mood expensive.
why_selected: Best of the more dramatic sculptural looks while still preserving Devi's core features.
Massive cape architecture makes this feel unmistakably Met instead of generic gala.
Dark arch framing gives built-in luxury contrast for copy-led cards.

looks.label: Iridescent carpet power gown
looks.face_fidelity: Good face continuity with a more polished carpet finish.
looks.glam_impact: Rich iridescent fabric and broad shoulders feel current and expensive.
looks.outfit_clarity: Shoulder line, waist structure, and train stay distinct in feed.
looks.lighting_polish: Balanced paparazzi corridor light keeps details crisp.
why_selected: Strong clean-skin result from the earlier Met pack with premium shoulder architecture.
The jewel-tone surface gives the set a darker, cooler fashion note.
Excellent paparazzi-lane environment for sharper editorial one-liners.
